<div class="wv-epigraph">{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|“I’ve known him all my life,” Andra said, her voice thick with emotion.}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|— ''House of Blades'', chapter 15}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Andra Agnos Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Andra [[Agnos]] is a young girl of [[Damascan]] and villager descent, characterized by her blond hair and tanned skin. The daughter of [[Olissa Agnos|Olissa]] and [[Caius Agnos]], she has a younger brother named [[Lycus]]. Throughout her development, she grows from a thirteen-year-old girl into a fourteen-year-old [[Valinhall Travelers|Valinhall Traveler]], a status marked by [[black chains]] appearing on her forearms. While she is known for her playful and excitable personality, often making jokes or smirking during confrontations, she can also display significant [[Authority|authority]] and determination. In combat, she has utilized various tools and weapons, including a smith's hammer and a short [[sword]] featuring a black-spotted blade. Her experiences range from assisting her family with preparations in camp to engaging in combat against [[Golems|golems]] and [[Incarnations]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Andra is a thirteen-year-old girl with long blond hair. She has chain-shaped marks on her arms and carries a black-spotted, lightly curved blade.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|As a child, she has a tendency to get excited over small things. She attempts to prevent [[Simon]] from killing [[Erastes]], whom she has known her entire life.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Andra is the daughter of [[Olissa Agnos|Olissa]] and [[Caius Agnos|Caius]], and she is the sibling of [[Lycus]]. She was rescued by [[Simon]], who also gives her orders. Additionally, she has known [[Erastes]] her entire life and has attempted to prevent him from being killed by [[Simon]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Andra is a [[Valinhall Travelers|Valinhall Traveler]] who possesses the [[sword]] [[Seijan]], which is also described as a [[Dragon's Fang]]. She can currently use her powers to open her bedroom, the garden, and the bath.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|Orgrith Cave}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|Thirteen-year-old Andra [[Agnos]] is the sibling of [[Lycus]], and together they reside behind a mushroom-cap door.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c11">''House of Blades'', chapter 11</ref> After being trapped in a cave for nearly an entire day, Andra remained inside the cavern with [[Simon]].<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c11" /><ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c12">''House of Blades'', chapter 12</ref> [[Simon]] eventually rescued her after finding her curled up on a rock promontory situated above the [[rock worm|rock-worms]].<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c13">''House of Blades'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c14">''House of Blades'', chapter 14</ref> Having known [[Erastes]] her entire life, Andra attempted to prevent [[Simon]] from killing him.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c15">''House of Blades'', chapter 15</ref> While she possesses the [[sword]], Andra lacks any of the other gifts and can currently only open her bath, garden, and bedroom.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c18">''House of Blades'', chapter 18</ref> She brought five healthy sons and daughters to [[the Nye]].<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c18" />}}
